name: g_movieDecodeThreadStack
evidence: CreateMovieDecodeThread passes it as the stack (size 0x1000) of the thread it creates.

name: g_deferredRequests
evidence: the 1024-entry table of 0x80-byte requests QueueDeferredRequest fills and func_0019D4B0 sorts into buckets by group

name: g_cameraUploadedThisFrame
evidence: set by UploadCameraOncePerFrame when it runs func_00144848 on the camera and cleared by func_0019DAD8, so the camera goes up once between clears

name: g_soundBankHandles
evidence: bank handle per bank index, set by func_001BE268; cleared by func_001BF130

name: g_soundBankLoaded
evidence: per-bank flag func_001BE268 sets after loading, tested by func_001BE568

name: g_soundEntryAvailable
evidence: per-entry flag func_001BE268 fills for every entry of a loaded bank; func_001BE568 returns it

name: g_renderThreadStack
evidence: func_001E2398 passes it as the stack (size 0x20000) in the record that creates the render thread stored in g_mainAndRenderThreads.

name: g_memoryChecksumCursor
evidence: StepMemoryChecksum starts it at 0x100004 and advances it a word at a time as the next address to sum.

name: g_memoryChecksumRemaining
evidence: StepMemoryChecksum loads it with the byte count, subtracts 4 per word summed and finishes when it reaches 0.

name: g_memoryChecksumValue
evidence: StepMemoryChecksum starts it at 0xFFFFFFFF and keeps the running CRC in it; a nonzero value at the end sets D_00275C34.

name: g_requestSemaphore
evidence: the semaphore StartRequestThread creates, RunRequestThread waits on and QueueThreadRequest signals

name: g_requestRing
evidence: the ring of 0x200 two-byte requests (kind, argument) with its head and tail that RunRequestThread consumes

name: g_outputLine
evidence: the 0x80-byte line BufferOutputChar gathers characters in before it hands it to PrintToDebugConsole

name: g_remoteCallState
evidence: the remote call state: the next packet id, the request pool, the reply ring and the list of services (InitRemoteCalls sets it up)

name: g_fileClient
evidence: the remote call client OpenFileClient binds to the IOP's file service, which the file requests call

name: g_moduleLoaderBuffer
evidence: the 64-byte aligned buffer SendModuleLoadRequest sends and receives through

name: g_moduleLoaderClient
evidence: the remote call client BindModuleLoader binds to the IOP's service 0x80000006

name: g_moduleLoaderVersion
evidence: the module loader's version word that BindModuleLoader keeps and IsModuleLoaderMismatched compares

name: g_padClients
evidence: the two remote call clients InitPadLibrary binds to the pad module

name: g_padSlots
evidence: each port's four slots: the buffer of their two frames, their DMA words and whether they are open

name: g_padRequest
evidence: the 64-byte aligned request buffer the pad commands send and receive through

name: g_cardClient
evidence: the remote call client InitMemoryCardClient binds to the memory card server

name: g_vectorAPayloadPool
evidence: the pool of 16-byte tag 0x16 blocks (AcquireVectorAPayload)

name: g_matrixPayloadPool
evidence: the pool of 0x40-byte tag 0x17 blocks (AcquireMatrixPayload)

name: g_vectorBPayloadPool
evidence: the pool of 16-byte tag 0x18 blocks (AcquireVectorBPayload)

name: g_pairPayloadPool
evidence: the pool of 8-byte tag 0x19 blocks (AcquirePairPayload)

name: g_triplePayloadPool
evidence: the pool of 12-byte tag 0x1A blocks (AcquireTriplePayload)

name: g_imageEnd
evidence: the heap init (func_0018D430) rounds its address down to 16 to get the heap start.
